method: Agent visual inspection of rendered original PDF pages and crops, with printed source checked against both predictions. Not label-only adjudication.
target_definition: Observed supported advantage means at least one unambiguous source-supported high-over-low correction in the initial or repeat pairs, not a proven causal or consistently reproducible detail benefit. Nonpositive includes ambiguous/mixed cases, not proven absence of future benefit.

bulletins.verdict: No schedule differences. End-time label concerns are unchanged.

Initial high adds printed No Mass cancellations September 28 08:00, September 30 18:00, October 2 12:15. Labels omit all three, so raw F1 falls despite valid extraction. Both repeat runs capture them. Native text, not a scan-related improvement.

Repeat high wins label F1 by weekly baseline interpretation of Daily Liturgy but loses printed Monday Communion-Service exception. Native-text source contradiction; no unambiguous overall improvement.

Initial high wins label F1 by replacing Wednesday 11:45 confession plus dated noon with weekly noon. Noon is explicitly printed for September 23 only; weekly source says after 11:15 Mass. Policy permits calculated weekday confession times. Weekly noon extrapolation is ambiguous, not a clean resolution benefit. Repeat ties.

Initial high restores October 2 08:30 OLP Mass; directory resolves OLP to Our Lady of Pompeii. Native-text row omission. Repeat low restores it too; repeat high additionally inherits noon onto SPA row with no independent time, an ambiguous change.

Nine of ten pages scanned. Initial pair and targeted third pair tie. Repeat high drops clearly printed St John Vianney first/third Tuesday confession 17:00-17:45 that low captures. Small-text scan risk, but no observed high-detail benefit.

All five pages scanned. Initial high removes invented Thursday 11:00 Mass (cover and intentions show Mon Tue Wed Fri only) and restores October 28 healing Mass 19:00 printed on page 4. Repeat and targeted third pair both omit healing Mass, with no Thursday hallucination. Confirmed observed raster gain, not a consistently reproduced gain.

Initial high loses three moved-Mass cancellations and combined September 29 mission/reconciliation event versus labels. Mission timing prints combined components, not independent confession start; cancellation baseline interpretation also requires reconciliation. Repeat both omit more events. Semantic/policy ambiguity, not confirmed resolution gain.

Initial high's F1 gain combines removal of redundant October 12 16:00 Mass and calculated confession. October 12 flyer is raster-only, explicitly legible, and low reads it in both pairs; weekly Monday 16:00 already covers it. September 26 printed 8 PM conflicts with regular 8 AM. Repeat high additionally derives October 4 confession 18:15-18:30, plausibly omitted in labels. Mixed source/policy issues; no clean raster benefit.

Printed first full weekend plus explicit October 3/4 and November 7/8 confession dates. Initial low encodes first+second weeks, high first only; both weekly encodings fail to express varying Sunday ordinal correctly. Repeat low uses explicit dates and beats high. Native-text recurrence interpretation, not resolution gain.

Initial high omits seven daily adoration entries. Page 7 chapel advertisement prints Open Daily 6 AM-7 PM; text is native-extractable despite image background. Distinguishing chapel opening from exposition schedule is a policy question. Repeat both omit. No observed high advantage.

Repeat high chooses STM for Saturday confession under adjacent heading but appointment phone belongs to OLQP; labels retain optional alternate venue. High omits combined Stations/Rosary/Adoration 10-14 block, defensible under component-timing policy while labels require full adoration duration. Native layout/semantics, not unambiguous resolution benefit.

Initial high restores printed September 25 07:30 St Alphonsus cancellation. Repeat high correctly classifies First Friday 11:30 Sacred Heart Mass as monthly recurrence instead of one dated occurrence. Both gains native-text. High repeat also drops a raster Children's Adoration flyer with third Friday 09:30 printed; label omission makes that F1 gain questionable. Third pair ties.
